sanskrit_verse:
द्वयोर्विवदतोरर्थे द्वयोः सत्सु च साक्षिषु।
पूर्वपक्षो भवेद्यस्य भवेयुस्तस्य साक्षिणः॥
transliteration: dvayor vivadator arthe dvayoḥ satsu ca sākṣiṣu | pūrvapakṣo bhaved yasya bhaveyuḥ tasya sākṣiṇaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In a dispute between two parties concerning a matter where both have witnesses, the burden of proof lies with the party asserting the prior claim.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is established through the integrity of initial assertion
Causation follows the sequence of conscious declaration
Capacity-based responsibility arises from the ability to substantiate one's position
Restoration logic prioritizes alignment with factual precedence
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of primacy in truthful establishment
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this principle establishes that the threshold of responsibility lies with the party who first declared the contested right or fact. The court shall not entertain equal weighting of testimonies when precedence of conscious assertion determines ontological validity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality assigns consequence to the failure of sustaining foundational truth. Anupūrvaśaḥ reflects the sequential unfolding of dharma through rightful precedence. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to uphold declared reality. Non-punitive reality rule ensures correction occurs through completion rather than condemnation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate witness corroboration protocol for prior declarant
Engage factual alignment process for secondary claimant
Implement integrity reintegration for failed substantiation without punitive overlay
Activate consciousness restoration circuit to reaffirm truthful precedence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is hereby restored. Truthful precedence governs dispute resolution. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
